sql: select distinct lo.event_ticker, split_part(lo.event_ticker,'-',1) as series, regexp_replace(lo.event_ticker,'^[A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{3}[0-9]{2}([0-9]{4})?','') as game_token from live_orders lo where lo.strategy='Dmmsell10' and lo.action='buy' and lo.status='filled' and lo.market_ticker like 'KXMLB%-26SEP02%' order by game_token, series
